messages:
sam: Quick check — we want to deprecate the unpinned default on /v1/generate next month. Proposal: flip default to model-1.5, continue honoring Accept-Model header, 30-day grace period with clear Deprecation-Notice header, and return a 4xx machine-readable error when a client pins a model that's incompatible. Any immediate objections or gaps?

katie: +1 on the deprecation header. Past change caused SDKs to silently start using a different model; we should make the SDKs opt-in to default flips. Also call out migration steps in CHANGELOG.

matt: Two quick asks: 1) add a `Deprecation-Notice` response header and include the target flip date; 2) canonicalize the error shape for pinned model failures — suggest `error.code = \"model_mismatch\"` and `error.details` explaining compat.

sam: Agreed. Plan outline: banner on console, docs update, email to active keys 30/14/7 days before flip, then the flip + 30-day grace where requests without Accept-Model get the Deprecation-Notice header. Error shape example to use in spec:```json {"error": {"code": "model_mismatch", "message": "Pinned model not available in region or capacity tier", "details": "requested pin: gpt-4-variant-quantized"}}```

olga: Can we avoid breaking body shape for SDKs? Instead of changing the response body for missing headers, emit header + `x-sdk-deprecation-event` for telemetry, and for hard pin conflicts return the machine-readable error. Also we need a contract note for Dedicated customers who require advance notice.

matt: I support header-only warnings for older SDKs. Also add a smoke test: request without Accept-Model and with an explicit pin that doesn't exist -> expect 409 + `error.code=model_mismatch` and Deprecation-Notice when applicable.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: deploy-canary to prod on 2026-04-05T15:00Z. Will post PR checklist in #eng-releases.

katie: Code review ping @sam — I'll take a look once you add unit tests for header precedence, the smoke test Matt mentioned, and a short migration doc snippet.

sam: Thanks — PR up shortly: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1234 . ETA: EOD Friday for tests + changelog entry.

olga: Filing a follow-up ticket for Dedicated customer opt-out/contract wording. Will share link here when created.
